correctness.rationale: Independent exact GF(2) coefficient exhaustion (32,767 nonzero quartic forms), orbit generation using all 168 coordinate transformations (279 orbits), three-chart Jacobian Groebner smoothness checks over the algebraic closure (10,920 smooth weighted equations), and independently implemented binary-restriction factor testing reproduce the complete histogram (4666,3444,1722,504,420,84,56,24), 6,254 positive-line equations and 11,004 equation-line incidences. Binary degree-four form irreducibility iff no F4 projective root holds by minimum factor degree ≤2. The source and separate checker agree, but no theorem for other fields or degrees follows.
residual_risks: The arithmetic section test and algebraic-closure smoothness criterion are proved for the finite F2 degree-four universe; the separate factor checker in the package shares original smoothness labels, while the new independent checker recomputed all smoothness ideals.

value.rationale: Arithmetic Bertini splitting type (4) along rational lines is a natural invariant for smooth genus-three plane quartics, and q=2 is the sharp small-field setting where large-field existence heuristics are unreliable. The exact complete weighted distribution resolves a real incidence question, quantifying 4,666 instances with no inert rational line, not an arbitrary isolated table or known extreme endpoint. The result is self-contained finite mathematics and the exact eight-bin statistic is not mechanically determined by ordinary curve point counts alone.
residual_risks: Value is the incidence distribution, not the 78 old isomorphism classes or the already-known extremal curve.

limitations: Equation-weighted GF2 degree-four census; pre-existing known 78 classes and I=7 endpoint; full Dickson 1915 original tables inaccessible.
